action: Approve pilot scope, legal entities, data classes, allowed processing locations and global party minimum.
exit: Signed field-by-field purpose/recipient/physical-store matrix; no implicit right from a global ID.

action: Approve API boundaries, workload envelope and the remote revocation contract.
exit: Choose strict source-authorised reads or a bounded maximum 5s stale-authorisation window; record outage behavior and clock budget.

action: Profile real row sizes, indexes, retention, sharing density, skew and party degree without exporting restricted records.
exit: Replace every synthetic assumption with measured local aggregates; classify unknowns and agree forecast growth.

action: Create three isolated regional clusters with three AZs each, TLS, regional keys, backups and infrastructure as code.
exit: At least 3 nodes per region on independent hosts; local AZ failure and permitted restore drills pass. Country-local cases remain blocked until proper stores exist.

action: Introduce regional gateway authentication, workload identity, entity/purpose authorisation and database service credentials.
exit: Cross-entity reads and direct unauthorised writes denied; customer payloads never routed through excluded cells.

action: Replace full-owner scans with bounded indexed repositories, connection pools and keyset pagination.
exit: Read plans touch only requested keys; one scope cannot trigger a full party/history scan; max 50 rows / 32KiB page enforced.

action: Create a shared local unit of work and sovereignty hook, removing the global process lock.
exit: Business rows, controls, versions, outbox, audit and request receipt commit or roll back together; serialization retries and concurrent writers tested.

action: Version and sign generic Rego bundles; persist scoped facts separately; add decision cache keys and policy rollout fencing.
exit: Missing/stale bundle or facts fail closed; bundle revision, entity placement and resource epochs covered by tests.

action: Implement resource epochs, dependency indexes and bounded fanout work queues.
exit: A 10,000-relationship party change has bounded owner commit; authorisation revocation does not wait for graph rewrites; no stale epoch read. Policy commit advances a scoped authority revision and one reconciliation cursor without enumerating the affected population.

action: Introduce independently budgeted authority guard, operational outbox relay/CDC and bulk reconciliation lanes on regional durable transport.
exit: At-least-once delivery, per-key order, deduplication, bounded retries, quarantined errors and backpressure tested; raw excluded rows never enter a foreign bus. Separate relay paths, worker and connection budgets; bounded bulk transactions, byte/IOPS admission, per-entity fairness and independent retry/quarantine. No operational FIFO behind a policy campaign.

action: Build versioned delta import, graph closure and shared-resource deduplication under recipient controls.
exit: No dangling parent, cross-scope overwrite or replay resurrection; change only affected rows; deduplicated storage does not broaden any entity's rights.

action: Implement the selected remote-read and revocation design with priority control traffic.
exit: Strict mode pays measured WAN latency; lease mode binds a contiguous applied revocation watermark, expires fail-closed and stays within approved skew-inclusive bound. Report source effective, recipient enforced and physical convergence separately; stop only affected scopes when guard facts are unavailable.

action: Separate append-only evidence from ordinary telemetry; mask sensitive attributes and archive regionally.
exit: Denied routes leave source-only evidence; sampled traces contain no contact payloads; retention, holds and purge statuses are explicit.

action: Implement live purge, tombstones, backup retention and restore-in-quarantine procedures.
exit: Purge acknowledgement means live rows only; restored expired data cannot be served; audit/backup residuals documented per policy.

action: Build an open-arrival-rate test harness and deterministic full-scale synthetic data loader.
exit: 1M, 10M, 50M and 100M relationships with corresponding parties, children, indexes and policy skew; no small-dataset cache illusion.

action: Measure workload-specific p95/p99, errors and saturation per operation, cell and entity.
exit: Target peak 30k reads/s + 5k writes/s global for 60 minutes; 24h normal-load soak; dropped test iterations count as failure. Compare a 100M-scope policy campaign against equal-capacity baseline: operational SLOs hold and initial target is no more than 10% p99 degradation.

action: Run cold-cache, hot-key, compaction, backup and retry storms with controlled overload.
exit: No OOM or unbounded queue; admission control and foreground priority operate; record actual capacity knee and scale-out trigger. Reorder lanes and test stale backfill after a fresh update, old purge after regrant, policy-submit floods and bulk disk/lock contention.

action: Test node/AZ loss, WAN isolation, authority loss and a 30-minute recipient outage.
exit: No foreign failover or unsafe read; at least 1.5× recovery service capacity drains a 30-minute peak backlog in 60 minutes while new traffic continues.

action: Promote the isolated India relocation slice into a normalized-table migration with distributed writer fencing, gateway route epochs and pending federation handoff.
exit: Four-store CockroachDB test passes under controller/DB/OPA failures; source-writable copy, target-applied checkpoints, graph closure, idempotent handoff, no dual writer, deadline handling and separate live/backup disposal evidence. Measure cutover pause and foreground p99 under bulk load.

action: Create alerts, capacity dashboards, runbooks, ownership and on-call training.
exit: Lag age, oldest revocation, queue bytes, retry rate, lease expiry, DB resource use and error-budget burn alert correctly; operator drill passes. Display operational, authority and convergence health separately; bulk lag alone must not imply operational failure.

action: Run adversarial entitlement, leakage and failure-injection tests before bank-data access.
exit: Zero unauthorised payloads or metadata observed in forbidden stores/buses/logs; controls verified at infrastructure and API boundaries.

action: Approve a limited pilot, starting with read-only shadow operation and explicit rollback authority.
exit: Named acceptance sign-offs; approved initial cap 100k parties / 200k relationships across selected entities; synthetic full-scale test passed separately.

action: Canary a single contact/consent workflow, then holdings, with a controlled traffic ramp.
exit: 1% → 5% → 25% of pilot traffic with a 24h hold at each stage; rollback on leakage, epoch mismatch or sustained SLO breach.

action: Review operating cost, user experience, performance and residency evidence before expanding entities.
exit: Two-week stable pilot readout, measured capacity forecast and explicit go/no-go; approve new country cells before expanding their data footprint.
